description: Unit tests for MirrorChooser functionality in the org.fdroid.download package, testing mirror selection, fallback mechanisms, location preferences, and error sorting.

classes.name: MirrorChooserTest
classes.description: Test suite for MirrorChooser implementations, covering mirror selection, fallback, location-based ordering, and error handling.

methods.name: testMirrorChooserDefaultImpl
methods.description: Tests default mirror request handling with mock mirrors, verifying correct URL generation and result.

methods.name: testFallbackToNextMirrorWithIOException
methods.description: Verifies fallback mechanism when IOException occurs during mirror request.

methods.name: testFallbackToNextMirrorWithSocketTimeoutException
methods.description: Verifies fallback mechanism when SocketTimeoutException occurs during mirror request.

methods.name: testFallbackToNextMirrorWithNoResumeException
methods.description: Verifies fallback when NoResumeException occurs during mirror request.

methods.name: testMirrorChooserRandom
methods.description: Checks that MirrorChooserRandom preserves the set of mirrors.

methods.name: testMirrorChooserRandomRespectsTryFirstMirror
methods.description: Ensures try-first mirror is prioritized in mirror ordering.

methods.name: testMirrorChooserRandomIgnoresMissingTryFirstMirror
methods.description: Ensures missing try-first mirror is ignored in ordering.

methods.name: testMirrorChooserIgnoresIpfsGatewayIfNoCid
methods.description: Tests that IPFS gateways are ignored if no CID is provided.

methods.name: testMirrorChooserThrowsIfOnlyIpfsGateways
methods.description: Verifies exception is thrown if only IPFS gateways are present.

methods.name: testMirrorChooserDomesticLocation
methods.description: Tests mirror ordering based on domestic location preference.

methods.name: testMirrorChooserForeignLocation
methods.description: Tests mirror ordering based on foreign location preference.

methods.name: testMirrorChooserErrorSort
methods.description: Verifies mirrors are sorted by error count, with fewer errors prioritized.

methods.name: testMirrorChooserDomesticWithTryFirst
methods.description: Checks that try-first mirror is prioritized in domestic location context.

methods.name: testMirrorChooserRandomization
methods.description: Ensures mirror order varies when error counts are equal, confirming randomness.
